summary: zero-knowledge share: render+encrypt a note (or tag collection) locally, publish only ciphertext
usage: ops share <slug> [--expires 7d] [--plain|--gist] [--dry-run|--yes] | collection <tag> | list | revoke <id> --yes | init
hints: Share a note or `collection <tag>` as ONE self-contained HTML blob, encrypted AES-256-GCM LOCALLY; only CIPHERTEXT is published to a Cloudflare Worker+KV and the key rides the URL `#fragment` (the provider can never read it). Transmitting subactions (share/collection/revoke) self-gate --yes -> EXIT_CONFIRM(3); `list` is free. `--dry-run` renders+encrypts locally and stops. `--plain` = unguessable slug, no E2E. `--gist` = secret gist fallback. Run `ops share init` once to deploy the worker. Common mistake: expecting it to send the link — output is a DRAFT link, the human sends it.
